title: Standard Voice Greeting
text: Thank you for calling customer support. My name is {agent_name}. May I please have your booking reference or the full name on the reservation?

title: Acknowledge Request
text: Based on what you’ve shared, I understand that you need help with {request}. Is that correct?

title: Commitment & Ownership
text: I can certainly take care of that for you right now, and I will guide you through all the available options step by step.

title: Probe for Passenger / Segment Details
text: To ensure we apply the correct airline rules, could you please confirm which passengers and which flight dates you are looking to modify?

title: Hold while checking GDS
text: Give me just a moment while I check this in our system so I can get you the most accurate options — I'll be right back with you.

title: Hold Extension / Still Checking
text: Thank you for holding. I am currently reviewing the fare rules and calculating the exact difference with the airline. May I place you on a brief hold for another 2 minutes?

title: Explain Partial Pax Split to Customer
text: Because only {pax_count} of your traveling party is changing dates today, we will separate their tickets into a new reservation first. The remaining traveler's booking will stay completely unchanged.

title: Rebooking Price & Breakdown Quote
text: To change the flight to {date}, the total cost will be {currency} {amount}. This includes the airline ticket difference, penalty, and our voluntary change service fee. Would you like to proceed with this option?

title: Mandatory Email Verification Gate
text: Before we can finalize this voluntary change on your ticket, airline security policy requires me to verify the email address registered on your booking. Could you please spell out your email address for me?

title: MOTO Secure Keypad Payment
text: We can complete this payment securely over the phone right now using our automated keypad system. You will enter your card numbers directly into your phone keypad so your details remain completely private.

title: Payment Link (30-Minute Validity)
text: I am sending a secure payment link to your registered email address now. Please note this link remains valid for 30 minutes. As soon as payment clears, our ticketing team will reissue your tickets.

title: ETG Service Fee Disclosure
text: Our standard voluntary rebooking service fee of {currency} {fee_amount} per passenger is applied for handling the changes and reissue directly with the carrier.

title: Confirm Explicit Agreement
text: So, as we have discussed, the agreed solution for you is {solution}. Before I finalize and submit this change to our ticketing department, do you confirm that you would like me to proceed?

title: 4-Part Voice Summary
text: To recap our call today: you called to {request}. We separated the booking and rebooked your flights to {date} for a total of {currency} {amount}. The request has been submitted to Ticketing, and you will receive your updated e-ticket confirmation by email shortly.

title: Professional Voice Closing
text: Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding your travel? Thank you for choosing our service, and have a safe and wonderful trip!

title: Too Close to Departure (<48h)
text: I see you would like to add {request}, but because your flight departs in less than 48 hours, the system no longer permits adding this from our end. We recommend purchasing it directly at the airport check-in desk.

title: LCC Cancellation Fee Warning
text: We can process the cancellation with the budget airline, but please note that handling fees apply, and budget fare rules determine the exact refund eligibility.

title: Involuntary SC / FM Notice
text: Because this schedule change was initiated by the airline, you are entitled to involuntary change handling with no additional ETG voluntary service fee.
